environment.testData: C = "Lictorix Geo"; W1 = licter.com, W2 = onclusive.com, W3 = sqlite.org, W4 = example.com
environment.stateChanges: No analysis created. Wizards left via Back to Dashboard > Exit and Discard.

sideFindings: Lettermark fallback reachable only on an image load error: with the s2/favicons request aborted, the card shows the green "L" (SIDE_lettermark_when_favicon_fails_to_load.png). Google answers 404 + globe image for sites without favicon, so in practice the globe is shown (TC-004, known limit).
A failed /brands/logo request (aborted during exploration) still ends on the favicon image (graceful fallback, no error shown).
The domain line under the brand name appears with the placeholder and makes the card grow 54 -> 61 px; the avatar keeps 32x32 (no shift of the avatar itself).

results.notes: Executed in full; every observable step passes. C = "Lictorix Geo" ("Licter" is a Brandfetch suggestion, see GEO-1260/1261 runs). Given: green 32x32 span lettermark "L", empty field. Typing "licter.com" (one char at a time): avatar unchanged, no lookup request. On blur: avatar replaced by span "h-8 w-8 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-slate-200" (32x32, empty, no text) for ~205 ms, then 32x32 src https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=licter.com&sz=64 (Licter "lic ter" mark). "licter.com" appears under the brand name at the same time as the placeholder (card height 54 -> 61 px because of the domain line; the avatar itself keeps 32x32, no shift). Same 32x32 size as a selected suggestion logo (Nike: ). Network: exactly one GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=licter.com (+ the favicon image s2/favicons -> t3.gstatic.com faviconV2 redirect). Request names for the other TCs: "brands/logo" (lookup) and "s2/favicons" (image).

results.notes: Fresh wizard (full page load, Exit and Discard of the previous one) so that no domain was cached. "onclusive.com" typed one character at a time (200 ms per key): 0 lookup requests and avatar stays the letter "L" during typing (MutationObserver log: no avatar change). Enter: step not submitted (still Brand & Country, focus stays in the field), placeholder "animate-pulse bg-slate-200" 32x32 for ~195 ms, then the onclusive.com favicon image. Network: exactly one GET /geo/api/v1/brands/logo?domain=onclusive.com (7 ms after Enter), none for partial values; a later blur of the same value sent no second lookup. Visual = Google favicon fallback (Brandfetch quota exhausted on staging), which is the onclusive.com logo mark. Placeholder captured in DOM log only (too short for a screenshot without delay; see TC-004 step2 for the visual).

results.notes: W3 = "sqlite.org" (real site with a favicon). On blur: placeholder (DOM log), one GET /brands/logo?domain=sqlite.org returning {"domain":"sqlite.org"} (no logo), then s2/favicons?domain=sqlite.org&sz=64 showing the SQLite feather favicon (natural size 16x16, rendered 32x32) instead of "L"; "sqlite.org" under the brand name. Limit: as stated in the TC description, with the Brandfetch quota exhausted on staging every domain falls back to the favicon, so the "no logo in the brand logo service" precondition cannot be told apart from the quota error; the favicon fallback itself is verified.

results.title: Lettermark is shown when neither a logo nor a favicon is available
results.error: Expected: the 32px avatar shows the letter "L" (neutral lettermark) when the domain has neither a brand logo nor a favicon. Observed: a generic grey globe image is shown (, 16x16 natural; Google favicon service answers 404 with the default globe image, so the image does not fail to load and the lettermark fallback is never triggered). Known limit (OS-Team, 2026-10-14) - PO to confirm whether the globe is accepted.

Placeholder visible in step2_when (the /brands/logo response was delayed 2.5 s with a Playwright route, test aid only, to capture the transient placeholder; response unchanged). results.notes: Given: "Lictorix Geo" + website "licter.com" confirmed (licter favicon logo, "licter.com" under the name) + market United States / English (EN). Edit: field selected and "onclusive.com" typed character by character: avatar still the licter.com logo and "licter.com" still under the name while typing, no request. Blur: full DOM state log = [licter logo + "licter.com"] -> [placeholder + "onclusive.com"] (~435 ms) -> [onclusive.com favicon + "onclusive.com"]; no recorded state ever paired the licter.com logo with "onclusive.com". Discover Categories: POST /analysis/discover-categories with entityDomain "onclusive.com" (categories "Geospatial Analytics Software", "Location Intelligence Platforms"); Back: Brand & Country shows "onclusive.com" with the onclusive.com logo, field value "onclusive.com", no new lookup. Visuals are Google favicon fallbacks (Brandfetch quota exhausted on staging). Extra screenshots: TC-GEO-1262-005_after_blur.png, TC-GEO-1262-005_categories.png.
